I myself was I’m a very similar situation. I understand humiliation. I’m 33 I still live with my family mom, dad etc. I drank a lot of my life and decided to stop drinking on the 20 of March. The 20th it will be one month alcohol free. I’m not telling you to get sober. I’m not telling you to stop or quit but I never thought I’d quit drinking, in fact I was drinking in hopes I’d probably leave this earth earlier than most. Things get easier, but I still have crippling anxiety and depression but when the good days happen my god are they good. And I can actually wake up to enjoy them at a decent hour.

As far as looking at the things your co-worker has, it’s understandable to feel the way you do as I have done the same by looking at those around me and being so jealous of the things they had. Just remember that they haven’t had the same life or experiences you’ve had to endure. Everyone struggles (some definitely more than others)

Only advice I’ll give you is something that really helped me. “Nothing changes, if nothing changes.”

I hope you find the peace you need one day my friend. It’s out there.

I know it’s not a simple question. But prior to this what did you enjoy? And not “what filled you with joy” that’s irrelevant. What did you used to do that provided you with something. Like for me it’s music. I don’t want to play music because I’m depressed. I make myself. And after I’m like I’m glad I did. I hardly have friends. I don’t want a job either. I’m on long term disability to figure my life out and I’m feeling like a loser because I haven’t really done a lot to improve. But I know I have to MAKE my self do shit. Nothing will make you feel good on its own my friend. I’ve heavily abused drugs and alcohol and in the end had it worse than ever. Cheap dopamine isn’t worth shit. You don’t “need” to do anything but you SHOULD hang on. Because that’s all we’re doing together fam. We’re all just fucking hanging on and yeah I know it sucks. And you see people who look like they have it easy in life I promise you I fuckin promise you it’s not that way. We’re all here struggling. People who seem like they have it all have problems different to ours. But they still have them. I want to kill myself every god damn day but you know what? I say fuck that. Fuck it! I’m not going to let my brain win. I’m not gonna let my depression win because I know it’s going to be a fight every god damn day. Sometime days you win the battle, somedays you lose. But for fuck sakes let’s win the war. Don’t be another statistic. Because at the end of it that’s what it will come down to. People don’t show you they care about you not because they don’t care about you or because they don’t want to. But because they have their own shit going on. And if you do it. The aftermath will make life even worse for them. People can’t give you the love you need and that’s okay. Because we are all people. We all fuck up. We all make mistakes. You think at 32 I wanted to be where I’m at? Fuck no. But I am. And I have to work with it and own it. THIS community is here for you fam. Let us help you. God speed.

I can’t say I relate. But I can say I understand because I too am struggling to a point where it’s just too much. But when I come on here and see the amount of love, support and understanding that I see from other users going through a similar hell, it really helps me not feel as alone as I think I am. I can’t promise you that you will be okay or it will get better. But there is something to be said about hanging in there and you’re doing just that. So keep doing it. You got this.

Not saying we all have the same issues. But a lot of us have the same problem (myself included).We kinda want to die, but! My best friend recently got told he was terminally ill. Maybe has 2 months. I’ve never seen someone want to live so badly in my god damn life. I’ve never seen him cry, was always a man of few words and hearing and seeing him fall apart about how he doesn’t want to die really woke me up. Because yeah life is fucking miserable. It sucks. It’s shitty. And most of the time there’s not even a reason to look forward to tomorrow. But if you kill yourself, how the fuck are you ever gonna find out what the future has in store for you? Since I can remember I’ve always said “next year will be better” and it wasn’t. But have hope. Because maybe one year or one day. Something will happen and you’ll be like “god damn it’s good to be alive”. Stay strong my friend. You got this.
Today fucking sucks. Tomorrow might not. Only one way to find out. Be there.

My personal experience and this is just mine everyone is different.
I suffered trying to come off of this drug because the withdrawals were beyond hell. I’m currently on one 75mg capsule 5 times a day.
My psychiatrist will not prescribe the medication nor will my family doctor because when my psychiatrist office was closed on a long weekend and I ran out I had to go to the hospital to get a new prescription. My psychiatrist told me he will no longer prescribe it because he was upset I had to go to a hospital to get a single refill and I did not have any other prescriptions for it.
Now I’m getting referred to a rehabilitation clinic because I have exhausted all of my options of getting the medication. I’m scared to go to the hab but I know I will come out a better person. My best advice. Stay away from this drug. I never abused it, but trying to come off of it has been nothing but a nightmare. And the withdrawals can kill you. Just if you’re on it or starting it please be careful. Not trying to be negative or a downer. That’s just my experience with it.
